summary: The old vspone_block parameter names renamed in 13.7.0 remain as aliases for backward compatibility but will be removed in the next major release.
questions: Do the old vspone_block parameter names still work?
When will vspone_block aliases like nick_name be removed?

answer_card.title: vspone_block old names kept as aliases
answer_card.answer_md: The parameter names renamed in this release (for example `nick_name`, `ports`, `port`, `start_ldev`, `mirror_unit_id`, `pvol_status`, `parity_group`) are kept as **aliases** for backward compatibility, but will be **removed in the next major release** of hitachivantara.vspone_block. Update playbooks to the new names.
